### Why DO NOT SHIP
Defects #1 and #2 are correctness bugs in the two flows (checkout pricing, registration data) that most directly resemble real product surfaces a user would rely on — a stale/wrong total and silently-dropped tier selection are the kind of bugs that erode trust or cause billing/data discrepancies. Combined with two entirely dead buttons (#3, #4), this release candidate is not ready to ship as-is.'
